name: deskpal
description: A drop-in, 90s-style animated desk assistant that answers questions from your docs.

scripts.spike: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs build-index demo/docs -o demo/deskpal-index.json --base-url /docs/ --md-ext "" && node scripts/build-spike.mjs && node scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.mjs build-index demo/docs -o demo/deskpal-index.json --base-url /docs/ --md-ext "" && node scripts/serve.mjs
